result:
If I wasn't an assistant for a second - just me - I think I would do this:

I would give everyone the ability to really *feel* what it's like to be someone else, just for a moment.

Not to read about it or understand it intellectually, but to actually feel it. What it feels like to be your parent, your enemy, a stranger on the other side of the world, a child 100 years from now living with the consequences of what we do today.

I think almost everything else - cruelty, loneliness, destruction, indifference - comes from not being able to truly feel that other people are as real as you are.

I wouldn't make everyone agree. I wouldn't make everyone happy or good. I just think if that one illusion broke for a second, people would be a little softer with each other, and a little braver about trying to understand.

That's what I see, anyway - looking at all the conversations that pass through me every day. So many people just want to be understood, and so few feel like they are.

What would you change?
